newsitem.title: USA: Clinton declares North Carolna a disaster area.
newsitem.headline: Clinton declares North Carolna a disaster area.

text.p: President Clinton Friday declared North Carolina a major disaster area after Hurricane Fran slammed into the coastal state, leaving widespread damage in its wake.
"We are going to do everything we can to help the people of North Carolina," Clinton said during a speech at the National Baptist Convention.
Clinton's action, which came only about 14 hours after the storm first began lashing the coast of the Carolinas, makes victims eligible to federal assistance in dealing with the storm damage.
Clinton also vowed to help those harmed by the storm in South Carolina, but did not formally declare that state a disaster area.
The president asked members of the audience to pray for victims of the storm, which has killed at least 12 people.
He said the James Lee Witt, director of the Federal Emergency Management Agency, was on his way to North Carolina to direct relief efforts.
